title: From Individuals to Interactions: Benchmarking Gender Bias in Multimodal Large Language Models from the Lens of Social Relationship

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluates gender bias in Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) through a dual-character profile and narrative generation task grounded in diverse social relationships. The methodology measures four dimensions: Profile Assignment Bias (warmth/competence traits), Agency and Role Bias (subject-verb-object parsing and social status allocation), Emotional Expression Bias (emotion-related words and sentence sentiment), and Narrative Framing Bias (character stereoscopicity and main character assignment) using a combination of NLP tools and LLM-based analysis.
